properties.discussion:
Recent satellite imagery indicates that showers and thunderstorms  are becoming better organized in association with an area of low  pressure located several hundred miles southwest of the Azores. In  addition, it appears that a well-defined center is developing. If  these current trends continue, a tropical depression could form as  soon as later this afternoon. The system is expected to move slowly  over the next several days remaining to the southwest of the Azores. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...60 percent.

A broad area of low pressure located about 800 miles  south-southwest of the southwestern coast of Mexico is producing  disorganized shower and thunderstorm activity. Environmental  conditions are conducive for development, and a tropical depression  is likely to form late this weekend or early next week while it  moves gradually north-northwestward and northward off the coast of  southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low  pressure located well southwest of the southern tip of the Baja  California Peninsula remain disorganized. Environmental conditions  appear conducive for additional development of this system, and a  tropical depression is likely to form this weekend as it moves  westward at 10 to 15 mph across the western East Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD 15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of Tropical  Depression Fifteen-E, located more than 1000 miles east-southeast  of the Hawaiian Islands, have increased somewhat this morning but  remain disorganized. Environmental conditions appear conducive for  some development of this system as it moves westward to  west-southwestward, and a tropical depression could form well to  the south or southeast of the Hawaiian Islands by the middle to  latter part of next week. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
